title: Spiced Hake Pie
description: A flavorful and spicy pie made with the delicate flavor of hake, all within a vegan and yeast-based crust.
instructions: 2. Thaw the hake and cut it into small pieces.
3. Mix the yeast, water, and a pinch of sugar in a bowl. Let it sit for 5 minutes.
4. In a pan, heat the oil and sauté the hake pieces until they're browned.
5. Add the curry powder, salt, and a squeeze of lime juice to the pan and mix well.
6. Roll out the vegan pie crust mix according to the package instructions.
7. Fill the pie crust with the hake mixture and cover it with another pie crust.
8. Bake the pie in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the crust is golden brown.
